title: TOP Ori Tahiti Basics Steps Beginners  / How to Tahitian Dance Tutorial Workout

method.teacher_system: The teacher first checks posture and knee position. Then she breaks down individual basic steps one by one, explaining hip and foot movements. Finally, she combines everything into practice rounds with music.

practices.what: Teacher explains and demonstrates the first basic step, the Tamau, moving hips side to side.
Teacher introduces the Ami, a circular hip motion with bending knees and stationary upper body.
Teacher teaches the Varu, a figure-eight hip movement with matching foot action.
Teacher demonstrates the Faarapu, smaller and faster hip circles.
Teacher leads a full practice round combining all learned steps together to music.

moments.says: The teacher welcomes the learner to the dance fitness class, introducing herself and outlining the workout for top basics.
The teacher reminds the learner to check their posture, keep their back straight, neck tall, and maintain a neutral pelvis.
The teacher encourages the learner to go faster while keeping their arms still and pushing their hips further.
The teacher praises the learner for keeping going during the practice routine and tells them they are doing great.
The teacher expresses pride in the learner, invites them to share in the comments, and points to the next class link.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling encouraged, capable, and proud of their progress in mastering Tahitian dance basics.

struggles.theme: Hips and lower back feel exhausted and sore
Difficulty coordinating knees and feet during circles

clicked.theme: Steps are well explained and easy to follow

requests.theme: Tutorials for more advanced steps or songs
Information on where to get or make skirts

meant.theme: Brought joy, great workout, and visible progress over days

method.limits: Audio is partially dubbed or includes recorded music tracks; some specific cultural historical details beyond steps are not explained.
